item.title: Azerbaijan, US hold Strategic Working Group Meeting on partnership charter
item.description: On 21 January 2026, the second online meeting of the Strategic Working Group, led by the Deputy Foreign Minister Elnur Mammadov and Deputy Assistant Secretary of State Sonata Coulter, to develop the Charter on Strategic Partnership between the Republic of Azerbaijan and the United States of America, was held.

item.title: Qarabag beat Eintracht 3–2 in dramatic Champions League clash in Baku
item.description: The match between Qarabag and Eintracht (Germany) in Baku, as part of the 7th round of the main stage of the UEFA Champions League, has ended.

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev shares post on victory of Qarabag football club
item.description: President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev has shared a post on his social media accounts regarding the victory of Qarabağ football club, Azernews reports.

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev meets with CEO of Vitol in Davos
item.description: On January 21, President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev met with Russell Hardy, Chief Executive Officer of Vitol, in Davos, Azernews reports.

item.title: Trump says US and NATO shaped framework for Greenland and Arctic agreement
item.description: US President Donald Trump has announced that the framework for a future agreement on Greenland and the wider Arctic region has been shaped following what he described as a “very productive” meeting with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte.

item.title: How Azerbaijan turns energy wealth into long-term growth
item.description: Azerbaijan has long been known as a country shaped by mega projects. item.title: NATO Chief warns Europe not to lose focus on Ukraine amid Russian attacks
item.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has urged European leaders not to allow other geopolitical debates to distract them from supporting Ukraine amid ongoing Russian attacks, particularly strikes targeting the country’s energy infrastructure.

item.title: Azeri light sees over 2% drop in international markets
item.description: The price of Azerbaijan’s Azeri Light crude oil delivered to Italy’s Augusta port on a CIF basis declined by $1.44, or 2.07%, compared to the previous session, settling at $67.95 per barrel, Azernews reports.

item.title: Washington and Baku deepen economic ties with new business mission
item.description: The U.S. Chamber of Commerce, in cooperation with the U.S. Department of State and the U.S. Department of Commerce, is organizing its first-ever bilateral business mission to Azerbaijan, Azernews reports, citing local media outlets.

item.title: Foreign investment in Azerbaijan rises sharply with UK and UAE leading
item.description: In 2025, a total of 21,226.1 million Azerbaijani manats (about 12.49 billion USD) were invested in fixed capital from all financial sources for the development of Azerbaijan’s economic and social sectors, Azernews reports.
